source_summary: Tall ink-and-color Chinese landscape with layered mountains, mist, pine forests, ravines, small roofed hamlets, cascades, foreground groves, and waterside pavilions. Calligraphy and seals at the upper right are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_peak_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the monumental upper-left mountain group: clustered rounded peaks and a high dark vertical cliff face, with pale ochre-grey washes, dry-brush vertical striations, dotted vegetation accents, and soft misty edges around the summits.
must_preserve: vertical hemp-fiber texture strokes on the rock faces
dark ink washes on the central high cliff
small dotted shrub marks along ridges
soft atmospheric wash separating peaks from sky
rounded layered peak geometry

motifs.name: right_cliff_waterfall_mist
motifs.description: Isolate the right-middle cliff system with a narrow white waterfall dropping through a mist gap, flanked by rounded rock masses and dark shaded recesses.
must_preserve: thin pale waterfall line with dark ink edge
misty blank vertical opening around the falls
rounded rock contours with dry-brush texture
dark hollow shadow at the lower cliff base
subtle grey-brown wash gradients

motifs.name: left_terraced_pine_slopes
motifs.description: Isolate the left middle descending hillsides with layered, wave-like ridges, terraced contour bands, and dense small pine clusters at the lower slopes.
must_preserve: parallel contour strokes following the slope curves
rows of fine pine trunks and needle marks
dark dotted ridge vegetation
stepped terrace-like bands at the far left
soft transition into surrounding mountain wash

motifs.name: central_hidden_hamlet
motifs.description: Isolate the small central hamlet tucked among trees below the mountains: orange-red roof planes, pale walls, surrounding pines, and the narrow valley opening around it.
must_preserve: orange-red color accents on tiled roof geometry
thin black roof ridgelines and eaves
pale wall shapes partly hidden by trees
surrounding pine trunks and needle clusters
compressed valley setting between rock slopes

motifs.name: central_cascade_ravine
motifs.description: Isolate the vertical central ravine below the hamlet: winding white stream, small cascades, boulders, footpath-like banks, and flanking pines descending through the valley.
must_preserve: zigzag white watercourse with alternating dark banks
rounded boulder forms in the streambed
fine tree trunks and needle textures on both sides
layered rock washes enclosing the ravine
small dark pools and cascade breaks

motifs.name: right_mid_hillside_village
motifs.description: Isolate the right-middle hillside settlement and surrounding pine-covered rocks: small roofed buildings on the slope, angular orange roof accents, and clustered trees against rounded stone masses.
must_preserve: tiny tiled roof geometry with orange-brown color
dense vertical pine trunks and dark needle clusters
rounded rock outcrops with dry-brush shading
building walls partly obscured by trees
mist-softened edge where the slope recedes

motifs.name: foreground_twisted_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the broad foreground grove of twisting deciduous trees and pines over rocks, including dense leaf-dot canopies, gnarled trunks, low shrubs, and the small paths and streamlets threading between them.
motifs.role: foreground grove and rocky garden terrain
must_preserve: gnarled pale tree trunks with branching linework
dense stippled and scalloped leaf clusters
dark pine needle masses mixed with lighter foliage
large foreground rocks with shaded creases
small pale paths and water channels winding through the trees

motifs.name: lower_right_waterside_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right waterside pavilion group with a rectangular roofed building, willow-like trees, bankside rocks, small water channels, and pale open ground around the structure.
must_preserve: straight roof ridgeline and tiled eaves of the pavilion
pale wall panels and posts beneath the roof
drooping willow-like branch strokes
dark ink rock textures around the water edge
small pale water surfaces and bank contours

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
